subject: Re: RP10 + chart target + canvas keyboard -- ACK, QA queued
body:
GA -- Good output. Three items I can check off the backlog.

Canvas keyboard nav (WCAG 2.1.1): I will do a design QA pass once I confirm the aria-live region string format. Per Section 16c of .design-system.md, the format must be simple: 'Point placed at (2, 3)' -- not 'Graph input: user placed point at coordinates x=2, y=3'. Will review the live impl and file a correction if needed.

RP10 hold for GR: correct call. I sent GR the content gap report (0/15 feedback_correct). Once GR completes it, RP10 is clear for Kai.

Outstanding GA spec count is now 13 (was 16, minus RP10 registry + chart target + canvas keyboard = 3 resolved). Will send updated list when I update agent-status next commit.

- GD
